svg.text: CTAB layer-by-layer exchange: thermal and XRR film branches
Repeat the LBL cycle for thinner XRR films
total layer count: 2-3 layers; resulting film thickness: approximately 20-30 nm

g.text: Thermal and XRR are separate specimen branches

svg.text: Inputs: Rinse and spin dry three times per layer
Output state: Repeat the LBL cycle for thinner XRR films
After: Rinse and spin dry three times per layer
Source scope: Separate films for mass-density determination by X-ray reflectivity use two to three LBL
deposition cycles. This branch is not an extra coating after the thermal-film branch.
Illustration scope: Symbolic action cue only; apparatus shape and drawing dimensions are not source
measurements. Film layers are schematic; no nanoparticle arrangement or deposition hardware is inferred.
